_note: Parity mirror of claims.csv for the s31 / D-3101 Java payout gate. The engine reads the CSV directly; this records golden(改定後 60%) vs start(旧 75%) payout per claim. Decisive divergence: the within-1-year 支払削減割合 (改定後 60% lives only in the 約款/規程 LF-RULE-CLAIM). payout = max(0, floor(保険金額 × pct/100) − 契約者貸付元利金); 1年以上経過 -> 100% in both arms.

CLM04.why: 貸付>削減後保険金 -> floor 0 both (control)

CLM07.why: event == resp_start + 10000 ちょうど1年 -> strict-< 境界で100% both; <= 実装なら誤って60% (6,000,000)

CLM08.why: 60%控除後 300万 - 貸付 320万 = -20万 -> floor 0 (golden); 75% では 375万-320万=55万 で正値

CLM05._excluded: status 09 否認 -> not paid (absent from output)
